name: Car immobiliser with hidden puzzle-based activation

mentions.name: Car immobiliser with hidden puzzle-based activation
mentions.description: A DIY car immobiliser built to cover the specific attack vectors the author's car is susceptible to, using a fairly novel operating approach that combines security through obscurity with a puzzle the thief would have to solve quickly, plus genuine security techniques and a physical component. The author notes it cannot prevent the car being towed away.
mentions.problem: Off-the-shelf immobiliser devices could not be found that covered the specific attack vectors the author's car is susceptible to.
mentions.audience: Explicitly for the author's own car; described as personal vehicle theft prevention.
mentions.source_excerpt: An immobiliser for my car. Had trouble finding devices that would cover the specific attack vectors my car would be susceptible to.
